Read the [ordinary proof](PROOF.md), [uniform scalar proof](SCALAR-BOUNDS.md),
[complete exact evidence](EXPECTED.json), [recorded validation](VALIDATION.json),
and [predecessor credits](DEPENDENCIES.json). The paid author run used
CPython 3.12.14 with the standard library only. All 21 original
normal/optimized/cold math children passed, with 39 semantic
rejections in each lane. Those completed mathematical checks were
preserved during this release rather than replayed.

[PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json) embeds the whole original nine-file
seal and every reversible publication-status document edit. The
four programs, EXPECTED.json and VALIDATION.json are byte-identical
to that seal. Private/null publication fields in historical records
refer to their creation, not to current source or graph status.
[SHA256SUMS](SHA256SUMS) binds every current public file except itself;
the Git commit supplies its external anchor. Verify these source
and provenance identities without running mathematics:

    python3 -B verify_source.py

The separate reproduction command above performs the mathematical
checks afresh. Neither command constitutes independent review or
formal verification of the infinite ordinary theorem.
